description: Price from the local approved SteelProfil reference snapshot when configured, otherwise local WooCommerce and descriptions. Inspect reference timestamp, sales_terms, allowed_units, formats and minimum quantity. If format_required is true, ask for format_id. Never quote indicative_offer as a total or a conditional price without its condition. Owner policy: quantity gaps and overlapping boundaries use the next/higher volume tier (lower price). Other ambiguity gives requires_confirmation with no quote. Always state net/gross, unit, billable quantity, source and exclusions. Full availability is declared by the store owner, without inventory verification. Checkout discount is not verified.
